lessons.title: 28.1 Biostatistics
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain biostatistics and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Biostatistics applies statistical reasoning to biological questions, helping researchers summarise evidence and evaluate uncertainty.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: بایوسٹیٹسٹکس حیاتیاتی سوالات پر شماریاتی طریقے لاگو کرتی ہے تاکہ شواہد کا خلاصہ اور غیر یقینی صورتِ حال کا جائزہ لیا جا سکے۔
explanations.sd: بايو اسٽيٽسٽڪس حياتياتي سوالن تي شمارياتي طريقا لاڳو ڪري ٿي ته جيئن ثبوتن جو خلاصو ۽ غير يقيني صورتحال جو جائزو وٺجي.

lessons.title: 28.2 Types and quality of data
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain types and quality of data and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Data may be categorical or numerical; reliable studies define variables clearly, use suitable sampling and record measurements consistently.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

lessons.title: 28.3 Measures of central tendency
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain measures of central tendency and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Mean, median and mode describe central tendency; the median is less affected by extreme values than the mean.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

lessons.title: 28.4 Variation and visualisation
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain variation and visualisation and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Range and standard deviation describe spread; bar charts, histograms, scatterplots and error bars communicate different data patterns.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: رینج اور معیاری انحراف پھیلاؤ بتاتے ہیں؛ بار چارٹ، ہسٹوگرام، اسکیٹر پلاٹ اور ایرر بار مختلف ڈیٹا پیٹرن دکھاتے ہیں۔

lessons.title: 28.5 Experimental design
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain experimental design and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

A controlled experiment identifies independent, dependent and controlled variables, includes an appropriate control group and uses repeatable methods.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: کنٹرول شدہ تجربہ آزاد، تابع اور قابو میں رکھے گئے متغیرات کی شناخت کرتا ہے، مناسب کنٹرول گروپ اور قابلِ تکرار طریقے استعمال کرتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which statement best describes biostatistics?

options.A: Biostatistics applies statistical reasoning to biological questions, helping researchers summarise evidence and evaluate uncertainty.
options.B: Data may be categorical or numerical; reliable studies define variables clearly, use suitable sampling and record measurements consistently.
options.C: Mean, median and mode describe central tendency; the median is less affected by extreme values than the mean.
options.D: Range and standard deviation describe spread; bar charts, histograms, scatterplots and error bars communicate different data patterns.

questions.explanation: Biostatistics applies statistical reasoning to biological questions, helping researchers summarise evidence and evaluate uncertainty. This is the central principle of biostatistics.

options.D: رینج اور معیاری انحراف پھیلاؤ بتاتے ہیں؛ بار چارٹ، ہسٹوگرام، اسکیٹر پلاٹ اور ایرر بار مختلف ڈیٹا پیٹرن دکھاتے ہیں۔
